newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 15 muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 15 muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 15 municipal bond issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Coon Rapids, Iowa, $4.525 million general obligation improvement bonds.
--Potawattamie County, Iowa $2.4 million of GO capital corporate purpose bonds.
--Pottawattamie County, Iowa, $9.8 million of GO capital corpoprate purpose bonds.
--Laurel, M.D., $13.255 million public improvement refunding bonds.
--Lacey Township Board of Ed, N.J., $16.790 million school bonds.
--Tuscola County Building Authority, Mich., $2.2 million of building authority bonds.
--Lacey Township Board of Education, N.J., $16.7 million of school bonds.
--Falcon Heights, Minn., $1.6 million of GO tax increment bonds.
--Dallas, Texas, $6.5 million of equipment acquisition bonds.
--Harris County MUD #102, Texas, $1.475 million water and sewer revenue bonds.
--Utah Building Ownership, Utah, $16.86 million lease revenue bonds.
--Pawlet/Rupert Union, Vt., $2.1 million of GO bonds.
